capabilities: display the vault name in the file explorer
keep the vault title sticky while scrolling
extras: README includes screenshots but no usage instructions beyond installation steps.
intentEvidence: similar to pre 1.6.0 versions of Obsidian
motivation: Restores the vault name display that existed before Obsidian 1.6.0.
problem: Obsidian 1.6.0 removed the vault title from the side navigation file explorer, leaving no built-in way to see or customize it there.

relations.evidence: Pairs well with the Legacy vault switcher plugin.

summary: Obsidian plugin that displays and customizes the vault name in the file explorer header, restoring pre-1.6.0 behavior.
